QA Automation Engineer (Python & Selenium)

Email: priya.patel@email.com | Phone: +1 (555) 014-9921 | Location: Chicago, IL

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Quality Assurance Engineer with 4+ years of experience specializing in test automation for web applications and REST APIs. Junior QA Manual Tester
ALEX REYNOLDS

Junior QA Manual Tester

Email: alex.reynolds@email.com | Phone: +1 (555) 019-2834 | Location: Austin, TX

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/alexreynolds-qa | GitHub: github.com/alexreynolds-qa

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Detail-oriented and adaptable Junior QA Tester with hands-on experience in manual testing of web and mobile applications. Skilled in designing test cases, executing functional/non-functional tests, and documenting software defects using Jira. Strong grasp of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies. ISTQB Certified Foundation Level (CTFL).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Testing Types: Functional, Regression, Smoke, Exploratory, Sanity, Usability, API (Postman)

Test Management & Tools: Jira, TestRail, Confluence, DevTools

Databases: Basic SQL (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE queries)

OS Platforms: Windows, macOS, Android, iOS

Methodologies: Agile / Scrum, Waterfall

PROJECT EXPERIENCE

Web & Mobile E-Commerce App Testing (Personal Project)

Developed over 80 test cases and test scenarios based on functional requirements.

Performed cross-browser and cross-device testing across Chrome, Safari, iOS, and Android.

Logged and tracked 25+ bugs in Jira with step-by-step reproduction steps, severity ratings, and screenshots.

Conducted API testing using Postman to verify HTTP response status codes and JSON payloads.

WORK HISTORY

Technical Support Specialist | Apex Solutions Corp — Austin, TX | Jan 2024 – Present

Assisted end-users with troubleshooting software issues, translating user problems into detailed technical bug reports for the engineering team.

Collaborated with QA team members to verify fixed bugs prior to production release.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) — 2024

B.S. in Computer Science — University of Texas at Austin, 2020 – 2024

Senior Lead QA / SDET
MARCUS VANCE

Senior QA Lead / SDET

Email: marcus.vance@email.com | Phone: +1 (555) 018-4452 | Location: Seattle, WA

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/marcusvance-sdet | GitHub: github.com/mvance-sdet

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Lead SDET with 8+ years of experience designing scalable test architecture, leading QA teams, and driving quality standards across enterprise microservice ecosystems. Expert in TypeScript/Java, Playwright, Cypress, and AWS cloud environments. Experienced in managing cross-functional QA teams, setting test strategies, and implementing Shift-Left testing practices.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Automation Frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium

Performance & Load: Locust, k6, JMeter

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (S3, ECS), Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Terraform

Leadership: Team Mentorship (5+ engineers), QA Strategy, Test Metrics & Reporting, Shift-Left QA

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Lead SDET / QA Manager | CloudScale Technologies — Seattle, WA | Jan 2022 – Present

Led a team of 6 QA Engineers in architecting a modern Playwright + TypeScript test framework covering 12 microservices.

Shifted QA practices left by embedding contract testing (Pact) into early development cycles, reducing production defect rate by 35%.

Designed performance and stress test suites using k6 and Docker to validate peak traffic loads of up to 50,000 concurrent users.

Established company-wide QA metrics (Defect Escape Rate, Test Coverage, Automation ROI) presented monthly to C-level executives.

Senior QA Automation Engineer | HealthTech Solutions — Seattle, WA | Aug 2018 – Dec 2021

Developed Java + Selenium BDD (Cucumber) test automation solution for HIPAA-compliant medical applications.

Configured scalable automated test execution in AWS cloud using Docker containers.

Mentored junior and mid-level testers in object-oriented programming, Page Object Model (POM), and Git best practices.

Software QA Engineer | NextGen Apps — San Jose, CA | Jun 2016 – Jul 2018

Executed functional, API, and mobile automation testing for iOS/Android apps using Appium.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

M.S. in Computer Science — University of Washington, 2014 – 2016

AWS Certified Developer – Associate — 2023

ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager (CTAL-TM) — 2021
